claims.text: 根据美联储2025年1月29日的FOMC声明，委员会决定将联邦基金利率目标区间维持在4-1/4至4-1/2个百分点（4.25%–4.50%），本次决定是维持利率不变，而非调整。

citations.quotation: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.

Effective January 30, 2025, the Federal Open Market Committee directs the Desk to: Undertake open market operations as necessary to maintain the federal funds rate in a target range of 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.

counterarguments.text: 来源文本提到委员会在考虑未来进一步调整的幅度和时机，说明未来仍可能调整利率，但本次决定本身明确是“维持”。
